evidence: Touches src/net.cpp, src/net.h, and src/i2p.cpp under the P2P label to change I2P connection and session management.
rationale: Decouples transient I2P session creation from connection initiation to mitigate timing correlation attacks for outbound I2P connections. While worthwhile for privacy-conscious peer connectivity, transient outbound correlation is reasonably deferrable against broader P2P relay and consensus-critical concerns.
